title: Russian chain caption: the new 'Здесь' repeats the 'Здесь' that starts the sentence before it
detail: English is fixed: the globe filmstrip and paths captions show F right after 'from the identity ($t=0$) to $F$ ($t=2$), where', and 'The map is' is gone. The Russian 'где ..., где' is gone too. But the fix ends the sentence and starts a new one with 'Здесь'. The sentence before it also starts with 'Здесь': '... Нули отмечены точками, полюсы~--- кружками. Здесь $H_t$, ... непрерывно деформирует ... где ${H^{(2)}_{s}}'(p)=e^{-\pi i s/2}$. Здесь \[ F(z)=..., F=f_2\circ f_1, ... \]'. Two 'Здесь' sentences in a row read badly. This is in the LaTeX caption and in the PNG's own caption. The LaTeX itself compiles cleanly (pdfLaTeX and XeLaTeX, Russian as main and as second language, no errors, no overfull boxes).
evidence: Running v15 (work/vfy15e, built from notes/v15-candidate, sha256 matches c0f5037f), Phase view, deformation on: work/vfy15e/out/p-ru-film-homework.tex, p-ru-film-article1.tex; compiled: work/vfy15e/out/latex/v-article1-xelatex-ru-main.pdf p.3 (pdftotext: '... e^{-πis/2}. Здесь' then the display); PNG's own caption: work/vfy15e/out/p-capimg-ru-300.png (last line before the display).
fix: Keep one 'Здесь'. For example, start the display sentence with 'При этом' or 'Напомним, что', or start the earlier sentence with 'Деформация $H_t$, ...' instead of 'Здесь $H_t$, ...'.

title: Globe paths caption says the figure shows z_0, then says z_0 is not shown
detail: The filmstrip is fixed: z_0 is a square (green, black in B/W), drawn in (b) and (c), and the caption says 'The square is the image of the point $z_0=0$; in (a) and (d) it is on the far side of the sphere.' The slide has a key (dot H_t(0.8i), square H_t(0)). But the globe paths figure still lists the hidden point among what it shows: 'The figure shows the image of the set ..., the line ..., and the point $z_0=0$ under $F$ ... The point $z_0=0$ is on the far side of the sphere and is not shown.' The two sentences contradict each other. Same in Homework ('the point $A=0$') and in Russian ('На рисунке показан образ ... и~точки $z_0=0$ ... Точка $z_0=0$ ... не видна').
evidence: work/vfy15e/out/g-paths-article1.json, g-paths-homework.json, g-ru-paths-article1.json (cap; info.hidden = [z_0]); compiled: work/vfy15e/out/latex/v-article1-pdflatex-en.pdf p.2.
fix: Leave a hidden point out of the 'The figure shows ...' list, and keep only the sentence that says it is on the far side and not shown.
